Gvo Asset Management Ltd increased its stake in Ubiquiti Networks Inc (UBNT) by 8.16% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 55,700 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $5.51M, up from 51,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
